body_md:
These five HVAC companies are listed in Fort Myers or North Fort Myers with a named owner and a Certified Air Conditioning Contractor license checked in the Florida DBPR license lookup. Each license is Current, Active and expires 08/31/2028. Contacts were checked on 2026-10-31.

## How we picked

Each listing names an owner and an HVAC license from the Florida DBPR license lookup. Checked fields are license type (Certified Air Conditioning Contractor), license number, status (Current, Active), expiration (08/31/2028), and qualifier. Company-site statements are included only as given. License facts link to the DBPR detail page; site statements are tied to the company website in the record. Contacts were checked on 2026-10-31.

## At a glance

- All five licenses are Current, Active and expire 08/31/2028: CAC1813722 (Kobie Kooling, Inc.), CAC1819166 (Lewis Morris Air Conditioning, Inc.), CAC057717 (Stewart Air Conditioning Services, Inc.), CAC1818794 (Purtz Air Service, Inc.), and CAC1813319 (Hurricane Air Conditioning of SW Florida, Inc.).
- Issue dates in the record: Stewart Air Conditioning Services, Inc., 07/13/1998; Hurricane Air Conditioning of SW Florida, Inc., 07/24/2002; Purtz Air Service, Inc., 11/01/2016.
- Stated service areas: Southwest Florida (Kobie Kooling, Inc.); Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Bonita Springs, Estero, and North Fort Myers (Lewis Morris Air Conditioning, Inc.); Fort Myers, Naples, Port Charlotte, and surrounding Southwest Florida (Purtz Air Service, Inc.); Lee, Collier, and Charlotte counties, including Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Bonita Springs, Estero, and Lehigh Acres (Hurricane Air Conditioning of SW Florida, Inc.). A service area is not in the checked record for Stewart Air Conditioning Services, Inc.
- Fort Myers, FL: Kobie Kooling, Inc.; Lewis Morris Air Conditioning, Inc.; Stewart Air Conditioning Services, Inc.; Hurricane Air Conditioning of SW Florida, Inc. North Fort Myers, FL: Purtz Air Service, Inc.
